notes: Final round of the coverage gate (piece s4), 2026-10-13, corrected after the critics of that day: KIFI keeps no closings page (/weather/closings/ answers 404). On a storm day its newsroom types the day's closings into an article titled for the day ('School closures and delays for Wednesday, March 6', 2024, 19 entries; 'School Closures - Tuesday February 25, 2025', the last), and it gives a single closing a story of its own ('Taylorview Middle School closed Thursday due to down heat pumps', 2025-12-18; 'Teton County Schools Closed Tomorrow due to Jackson Boil Order', 2026-09-25; 'School canceled for Chief Tahgee Elementary Academy', 2026-10-07). Built as npg-articles-kifi (adapter wp-closings): the live poller reads the site's REST list of posts searched for 'school', the AP, CNN and Stacker categories left out, keeps only the station's own stories (a dateline crediting another outlet, such as the AP's, is not), keeps an article's rows while stamped within 36 hours, and takes the newest closings article's publication as the list's own time, judged by the closure-season rule like any list's. Proven by the March 6, 2024 article (history fixture npg-articles/kifi-20240306.json). In the winter of 2025-26 KIFI wrote no weather list: the market's one closure event, 2025-12-05, was a Winter Storm Warning for the mountain zones, and no district page on record closed for it; North Gem SD 149 (Caribou County) closed for weather on 2026-02-18 and KIFI wrote nothing of it. Counties: only those whose schools its closings articles named, 2022-10 to 2026-10 (12 Idaho counties and Teton County WY); Lemhi ID and Lincoln WY, never named, are not credited to it.
